blind.description: A classical stone cemetery monument consisting of a tiered square base, a tall square pedestal decorated with carved laurel wreaths in recessed panels, and an ornamental urn with a finial lid mounted on top. A sculpted funerary cloth or shroud is draped over one side of the urn, cascading down across the capital of the pedestal. Textures and geometry are solid, continuous, and stylized, resembling weathered carved limestone or marble with subtle green moss/aging gradients.
blind.from_above: Concentric circles of the urn lid and body set atop a square capital and wider tiered square base, with folded drapery gathered and extending outward along one edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: Stands about 4.5 to 5.0 feet tall (reaching roughly shoulder height on the 5 ft 9 in figure), with a base roughly 2.2 feet square.
